title: ndiffusion: multigroup neutron diffusion in C++ and Python
description: Multigroup neutron diffusion solvers for 1-D slab, cylinder and sphere geometries, 2-D structured XY and RZ meshes, and 2-D unstructured polygonal meshes: k-eigenvalue, fixed-source and time-dependent problems, with delayed neutrons. The solvers are written in C++17 and exposed to Python through pybind11; the Python package adds cross-section builders, mesh and core layout tools, post-processing, and a discretization-error estimator based on the method of nearby problems.
